summary: Admin order-request workspace (/admin/orders) fully verified end-to-end: access control, payment/fulfilment state guard, shipping/internal-notes persistence and privacy, duplicate-resistant conversion, admin-only cancellation, exceptional refund tracking, and manual WhatsApp preview. Existing checkout/catalog regression re-verified; one stale existing browser check (guest-checkout-and-account-ux) was repaired (field fill order + renamed testid) and now passes.

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_orders_access.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/order-requests unauth -> 401; as customer -> 403. As admin: GET /order-requests?q=<request_number> returns created row; GET /order-requests/{request_number} 200 with full name/address/note/items/quantity matching create payload.

checks.name: admin-orders-access-denied-and-workspace
checks.evidence: Unauthenticated /admin/orders redirects to /admin-login; admin login lands on /admin/orders; search by request_number and payment filter both surface the created tscheck row; clicking it shows full customer name, address and note plus item Qty in admin-order-customer/admin-order-items.

checks.name: test_tscheck_payment_fulfilment_guard.py
checks.evidence: PATCH fulfilment_status=Confirmed while Unpaid -> 409. PATCH payment_status=Paid without payment_verified -> 422; with payment_verified=true -> 200 + payment_verified_at set. Fulfilment then advances Confirmed->Shipped (200 each). PATCH payment_status=Unpaid after Paid -> 409 (no reversal).

checks.name: admin-order-payment-fulfilment-guard-ui
checks.evidence: UI: advancing fulfilment while unpaid triggers admin-order-error (409 in console). Setting Paid without checking admin-order-payment-verified triggers error (422). Checking the box + save succeeds, status shows Paid, then fulfilment advances to Confirmed and detail reflects it.

checks.name: test_tscheck_shipping_and_notes_privacy.py
checks.evidence: PATCH courier/shipping_details/tracking_number/tracking_link/internal_notes persists on re-GET. Separately: converted order's /account/orders snapshot for the owning customer contains no 'internal_notes' key and the secret note text does not appear anywhere in the snapshot JSON.

checks.name: admin-order-shipping-and-notes-persist-ui
checks.evidence: Filled courier/tracking number/link/shipping details/internal notes, saved, full page reload + re-search + reopen shows all five values still populated in their inputs.

checks.name: test_tscheck_order_conversion_dedupe.py
checks.evidence: Convert on unpaid/unconfirmed request -> 409. After Paid+Confirmed: first convert 200 order_number==request_number; second convert 200 returns identical order_id; history contains exactly one 'converted' event.

checks.name: admin-order-convert-no-duplicate-ui
checks.evidence: Convert button disabled while unpaid/unconfirmed; after Paid+Confirmed it enables, click flips label to 'Order already created' and disables; direct API re-convert call returns the same converted_order_id captured from the detail view.

checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_only_cancellation.py
checks.evidence: Cancel with reason 'bad' (3 chars) -> 422. Customer session cancel attempt -> 403. Admin cancel with valid reason -> 200, cancelled=true, history has 'cancelled' event; subsequent PATCH -> 409. Full paid progression to Delivered then cancel -> 409.

checks.name: admin-order-cancellation-ui
checks.evidence: Cancel button stays disabled for a 3-char reason, enables at 5+ chars; after cancelling, admin-order-cancelled-reason shows the reason, payment/fulfilment selects and save button become disabled, and admin-order-history contains a cancellation entry.

checks.name: test_tscheck_refund_tracking.py
checks.evidence: refund_status=Processing on unpaid request -> 409. On paid request: missing reason -> 422, amount=0 -> 422; valid reason+amount -> 200. refund_status=Refunded without refund_confirmed -> 422; with refund_confirmed=true -> 200, refund_confirmed_at set, refund_reference stored. Further refund_status change after Refunded -> 409.

checks.name: admin-order-refund-tracking-ui
checks.evidence: Refund on unpaid order rejected (admin-order-error). After marking Paid, Processing with reason+amount saves; selecting Refunded without checking admin-order-refund-confirmed is rejected; checking it and saving records a refund entry in admin-order-history.

checks.name: admin-order-whatsapp-preview-ui
checks.evidence: 'No message is sent automatically' copy visible; admin-order-whatsapp-preview textarea contains the request_number; admin-order-whatsapp-link href starts with https://wa.me/ and encodes the request_number; adding tracking number updates both the preview text and the link to include it, confirming no auto-send and manual review only.

checks.name: test_tscheck_checkout_creates_unpaid_request.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/order-requests (guest) -> 201 with SAF-REQ-* request_number; admin GET on it shows payment_status=Unpaid, fulfilment_status='Request received', cancelled=false. GET /api/products still returns exactly 4 products.

checks.name: public-catalog-accuracy-and-integrity
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: shop grid shows the 4 approved products with correct pricing/availability integrity.

checks.name: guest-checkout-and-account-ux
checks.evidence: Repaired persisted check (fill order country->state->city to match cascading-select disabled-state logic, and renamed stale testid checkout-payment-handoff -> checkout-whatsapp-handoff to match current markup) then reran: guest checkout builds cart, fills validated address, reaches review with WhatsApp handoff link containing wa.me, and customer login/logout flows still work.
